verses.pali: ekaṁ samayaṁ āyasmā vaṅgīso āḷaviyaṁ viharati aggāḷave cetiye āyasmatā nigrodhakappena upajjhāyena saddhiṁ.
verses.english: At one time Venerable Vaṅgīsa was staying near Āḷavī, at Āḷavī’s premier shrine, together with his mentor, Venerable Nigrodhakappa.

verses.pali: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā vaṅgīso navako hoti acirapabbajito ohiyyako vihārapālo.
verses.english: Now at that time Vaṅgīsa was junior, recently gone forth. He had been left behind to look after the dwelling.

verses.pali: Atha kho sambahulā itthiyo samalaṅkaritvā yena aggāḷavako ārāmo tenupasaṅkamiṁsu vihārapekkhikāyo.
verses.english: Then several women dressed in all their finery went to the monastery at Āḷavī’s premier shrine in order to inspect the dwelling.

verses.pali: Atha kho āyasmato vaṅgīsassa tā itthiyo disvā anabhirati uppajjati, rāgo cittaṁ anuddhaṁseti.
verses.english: When Vaṅgīsa saw them he became dissatisfied, with lust infecting his mind.

verses.pali: “alābhā vata me, na vata me lābhā; dulladdhaṁ vata me, na vata me suladdhaṁ;
yassa me anabhirati uppannā, rāgo cittaṁ anuddhaṁseti, taṁ kutettha labbhā, yaṁ me paro anabhiratiṁ vinodetvā abhiratiṁ uppādeyya.
verses.english: that I’ve become dissatisfied, with lust infecting my mind. How is it possible for someone else to dispel my discontent and give rise to satisfaction?

verses.pali: Yannūnāhaṁ attanāva attano anabhiratiṁ vinodetvā abhiratiṁ uppādeyyan”ti.
verses.english: Why don’t I do it myself?”

verses.pali: Atha kho āyasmā vaṅgīso attanāva attano anabhiratiṁ vinodetvā abhiratiṁ uppādetvā tāyaṁ velāyaṁ imā gāthāyo abhāsi:
verses.english: Then, on the occasion of dispelling his own discontent and giving rise to satisfaction, he recited these verses:
by the rude thoughts of the Dark One.
Even if a thousand warrior chiefs and great archers,
for I stand firm in the teaching.
I heard with my own ears
from the Buddha, Kinsman of the Sun,
about the path going to extinguishment;
Wicked One, if you come near me
I’ll make sure that you, Death,
won’t even see the path I take.”
